## The claim

The evidence ladder is independent of the measured aneuploid fraction: revising the mechanism card to version 4 with step 8's result (no autosome above its 2-3 % detection limit in the sequenced sample) changes no rung, no shortlist row and no do-not row; F8 acts only on how direction D2 is argued in the report, not on what it contains.

**Prediction if true.** Re-running tools/track2_enrich.py --skip-live on card v4 reproduces evidence_ladder.tsv, shortlist.tsv and do_not.tsv byte-identical to the card-v3 run (same sha256 for all three), while every manifest names card version 4.

**What would refute it.** Any row of evidence_ladder.tsv, shortlist.tsv or do_not.tsv differs between the card-v3 and the card-v4 run - a rung, a flag, a verdict or a rank moved without any input table changing.

| 133 | supports | 0.80 | measurement | Re-grading on card v4 from the cached tables reproduced evidence_ladder.tsv (sha256 47d1e415...), shortlist.tsv (77b6b352...) and do_not.tsv (a7b09e9f...) byte-identical to the card-v3 run, while all seven step-7 manifests name card version 4. | `methodology/120` |
| 134 | neutral | 0.50 | measurement | A first re-grade differed on all three tables, and the cause was not the card: the TSV reader applied the default CSV quoting, so a registry title beginning with a double quote swallowed 928 paediatric-trial rows (11,698 read as 10,770) and moved rungs; with quoting disabled in both readers the digests matched. Recorded as an instrument fault found by the pre-registered test. | `methodology/120` |
